infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The Void uses the rear camera only during an explicit, opt-in calm-state reading to estimate heart rate on-device. Frames never leave your phone.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: The Void reads device motion on-device to discard readings taken while you move. Motion data never leaves your phone.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: With your permission, The Void reads heart-rate/HRV from Health on-device to improve personalization. It is never used for ads and never leaves your phone.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Used only to protect on-device settings.

plugins.cameraPermission: The Void uses the camera only for an opt-in on-device heart-rate reading. Frames never leave your phone.
